criteria.title: Introduction
criteria.onvoldoende: No context or motivation. Missing problem statement.
criteria.voldoende: Basic context provided with a clear problem statement.
criteria.uitstekend: Rich context, strong motivation, and a precise research question.

criteria.title: Analysis
criteria.onvoldoende: Superficial analysis with no depth or supporting evidence.
criteria.voldoende: Adequate analysis covering the main points with some evidence.
criteria.uitstekend: Deep, thorough analysis with unexpected insights and solid evidence.
criteria.aandachtspunten: Consider: quality of argumentation, use of evidence, critical thinking.

criteria.title: Code quality
criteria.onvoldoende: Code runs but is poorly structured and hard to follow.
criteria.voldoende: Code is readable and reasonably well-organised.
criteria.uitstekend: Code is clean, modular, type-hinted, and self-documenting.
